title: Adult Cardiothoracic Anesthesiology Fellowship
Department: Department of Anesthesiology and Pain Management
Accreditation: ACGME-accredited (department states it offers ten ACGME-accredited fellowships)

title: Anesthesiology Critical Care Medicine Fellowship
Department: Department of Anesthesiology and Pain Management

title: Liver Transplant Anesthesiology Fellowship

title: Multidisciplinary Pain Medicine Fellowship
Department: Department of Anesthesiology and Pain Management
Summary: A 12-month ACGME-accredited fellowship including interventional, interdisciplinary, acute, chronic and cancer pain management on an inpatient and outpatient basis.

title: Neuroanesthesiology Fellowship
Department: Department of Anesthesiology and Pain Management

Application method: Department application form (documents uploaded via the fellowship home page)
Visa support: Not accepting or sponsoring training visas at this time
Summary: A 12-month programme training anesthesiologists in neurosurgical anesthesiology, neurocritical care, intraoperative neuromonitoring, stroke medicine, neurosonology and neuroradiology at a centre with over 4,000 neurosurgical cases a year.

title: Obstetric Anesthesiology Fellowship
Department: Department of Anesthesiology and Pain Management
Summary: An ACGME-accredited OB anesthesia fellowship based mainly at Parkland Memorial Hospital (about 14,000 deliveries a year) with affiliation to Clements University Hospital.

title: Pediatric Anesthesiology Fellowship
Department: Department of Anesthesiology and Pain Management

title: Pediatric Cardiac Anesthesiology Fellowship

Visa support: Not currently accepting or sponsoring training visas

title: Regional Anesthesiology and Acute Pain Medicine Fellowship

Visa support: Not currently accepting or sponsoring training visas

title: Undersea and Hyperbaric Medicine Fellowship
Department: Department of Anesthesiology and Pain Management
Application method: Department application form (documents uploaded via the fellowship home page)
Visa support: Not accepting or sponsoring training visas at this time
Summary: An ACGME-accredited 12-month programme at the Institute for Exercise and Environmental Medicine preparing physicians for subspecialty certification in undersea and hyperbaric medicine.

title: Cardiothoracic Anesthesiology Fellowship

title: Critical Care Anesthesiology Fellowship
inst: NYU Langone Health (NYU Grossman School of Medicine)

title: Obstetric Anesthesiology Fellowship
inst: NYU Langone Health (NYU Grossman School of Medicine)
Department: Department of Anesthesiology, Perioperative Care, and Pain Medicine

title: Pediatric Anesthesiology Fellowship

title: Obstetric Anesthesiology Fellowship

title: Pediatric Anesthesiology Fellowship
